cuts.head: over_shoulder
cuts.ofreeRecent: the central atrium of a space station — carries her keepsake low at her side; a quiet modern apartment window seat at night — she settles down to watch a film with a bowl of popcorn; a modern outdoor model-sailboat pond beside a bright white promenade in late morning — she enjoys steering a tiny remote-controlled sailboat around a buoy; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — rests the pen from a notebook against her lips; a cedar-wood tub by the window of a mountain inn — chest-deep in the water; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — kneeling on the ground; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — standing with one foot up on a step; a rocky waterfall pool under green trees — swimming freestyle at an easy pace; a sunny enclosed veranda with drying racks overhead — lying on her front; her tower bedchamber in a stone castle — kneeling on the ground; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing and leaning her upper body forward toward the camera from the hips; a retro American diner — seated on a chair; the moat path beneath the old Jingzhou city wall at dusk — twists the cap off a water bottle
